DETERMINISTIC RATIONAL-COMPLEX LINEAR-PARITY SUPPORT AUDIT
7 October 2026. Agent counting_gate_audit. Final interface audit at this checkpoint.

VERDICT
The proposed finite-field reduction is valid. It acquires exact maximum
cardinality and an actual independent paired witness over Q(i), hence an
exact support / zero decision for positive squared-Gram paired partitions
and forced/excluded prefixes. It removes the PIT false-zero error budget.
It supplies no partition approximation, sampler, mixing, energy comparison,
or FPRAS.

PRIMARY IMPORTED THEOREM
Hamada and Iwata, A Shortest Augmenting Path Algorithm for Linear Matroid
Parity, arXiv:2610.03030v1, submitted 2 October 2026:
 https://arxiv.org/html/2610.03030v1
Theorem 1.1 gives deterministic UNWEIGHTED linear matroid parity in
O(m r^2 log r) field operations, or O(m r^2) with fast multiplication, for an
r-by-m representation over a field K under uniform field cost. Sections
2.1/2.2 seek and maintain the actual independent paired column witness J.
Rank-deficient matrices are first reduced to full row rank. There is no
large-field or characteristic restriction; odd characteristic also avoids
characteristic-two ambiguity. No weighted optimization theorem is needed.
This is an imported optimization/witness theorem, not a counting theorem.
Its input/output/field-cost interface was checked in the primary text; its
entire augmenting-path proof was not independently re-proved or implemented.

EXACT REDUCTION AND BIT BOUND

L>=1 be its full rational encoding length. Multiply A by the product D of
all positive real/imaginary component denominators. Then G=DA is Gaussian
integer, D has O(L) bits, and the nonzero common scalar preserves column
independence over Q(i). A loose bound is |G_ij|<=2^(2L+1).

Any nonzero s-by-s minor delta, s<=r, obeys
 |delta|<=s! 2^((2L+1)s).
Its Gaussian norm N(delta)=delta conjugate(delta) is a positive integer.

 B=1+2r ceil(log2(max{2,r}))+(4L+2)r

in r,L. The rank-zero case is trivial.

CYCLE 4 — INDEPENDENT PAIRED-DPP COUNTING GATE AUDIT
7 October 2026. FINAL INDEPENDENT AUDIT AT THE CURRENT FRONTIER.
The overall research goal remains active; no general hard-BCS FPRAS established.

DECISIVE STATUS
The direct Chen–Liu intersection gate does not extend to the natural
both-or-none pair filter: its curvature hypothesis fails, and a rational,
well-conditioned, diagonal-zero six-site family defeats the needed
balancing-overlap conclusion even at an exact dual minimizer. Constant
fractional log concavity / constant sector stability of the pair-label
polynomial also fails on directed even cycles. These are counterexamples to
specified mechanisms, not impossibility results for all algorithms.

A different representation survives: the SIGNED AMBIENT-HOLE polynomial
is real stable. I independently verified its determinant construction, its
four-hole square-root triangle inequality, the uniform factor-three repair,
and closure under positive coordinate-pair auxiliaries. The initially missing
six-hole exchange has now been proved for ALL even sets by a self-contained
Pick-residue argument below, independently of the simultaneous Hurwitz
coefficient proof found by combinatorics_codes. This supports a new defect
calibration. Its coefficient-one exchange also gives a complete aggregate
logical-hole capacity theorem with OA113's unchanged D0=10^8(n+1)^4; full
derivation is in section 9. The microscopic determinant-weight
energy/congestion comparison remains missing; aggregate-hole exchange and
capacity are not themselves a sampler. A new deterministic finite-field
reduction also closes exact rational-complex support/zero/witness acquisition;
section 11 and work/cycle5/deterministic_parity_support_audit.txt give its
explicit theorem and every-execution bit interface.

LEGAL INTERFACE
For F in C^(n x n), f_i=row_i(F)^T, V=[I_n,F^T],

NEW FRONTIER / RESUME WITHOUT REPEATING THE SURVEY
7 October 2026. Internal research; not externally reviewed.

The campaign has not established a field-breaking result. Two sharper open
mechanisms now sit beyond the verified internal transfers. Begin here, then
read their exact latest reports; do not silently strengthen imported results.

1. DETERMINANT-WEIGHTED LINEAR MATROID PARITY

For explicit complex rational F in C^(n x n), let
 c_k(F)=sum_{I,J disjoint, |I|=|J|=k} |det F[I,J]|^2.
This is the k-pair norm of a hard onsite-projected opposite-spin BCS state.
With f_i equal to the transpose of row i, V=[I,F^T], and P(I) selecting both
columns (e_i,f_i), Cauchy--Binet gives
 c_k(F)=sum_{|I|=k} det((V*V)[P(I)]).
Equivalently retain only exponents 0 or 2 in
 det(I+sum_i x_i(e_i e_i*+f_i f_i*)), then replace x_i^2 by z_i.

The scalar sum_k c_k z^k is real-rooted by the audited clone identity.
Support, exact zero detection and witnesses also have a deterministic
polynomial-bit reduction to the imported Hamada--Iwata unweighted linear
matroid-parity algorithm. Clear rational-complex denominators, bound the norm
of a nonzero Gaussian-integer minor, and test polynomially many finite fields;
one preserves an optimum witness and all modular witnesses lift soundly.
Forced-pair contraction and excluded-pair deletion handle prefixes. The
algorithmic import and reduction have not been implemented here. The earlier
randomized Pfaffian route remains valid. Neither supplies a counting oracle.

New target: a polynomial-bit relative norm/coefficient algorithm and acquired
conditional samples for this exact weighted parity class. An appropriate
worm/defect representation would extend conditional hard-projected-state
preparation beyond the bipartite pair-matrix subclass. All oracle, support,
coefficient range, balancing, precision and sample costs must be charged.
